Description
Bright & warm UNFURNISHED 2 bdrm, 2 bath condo in Coal Harbour offering 1,100 sq. ft. w/ incredible harbour, water & mountain views from every rm. Open concept living w/ hardwood floors, gas cooktop, high-end s/s appls & living/dining rm w/ gas f/p & balcony. Master bdrm features 5-piece ensuite. In-unit washer/dryer, storage rm & 2 parking stalls. Building amenities incl. concierge, meeting rm, top-floor gym overlooking harbour & NS Mtns, outdoor rooftop garden w/ hot tub & gas f/p. Steps to waterfront, shops, Robson Street & downtown entertainment, Urban Fare nearby. Rental includes: Hot water, gas and 2 parking stalls. No Pets.
